"Cookie not found" — because my initial GET didn't save cookies (I used -c only on the login-flow curl which started a new session, losing the AUTH_SESSION cookie since I did `-L` to the auth endpoint... actually I did `curl -c /tmp/kc.jar ... -L "http://.../auth?...` — the first request goes to /auth which redirects to login page; with -L it follows. But the AUTH_SESSION_ID cookie should be stored to jar. Hmm, but then I did the first command then a separate command; kc.jar was recreated with `rm -f` at start of the second command! Yes — I deleted the jar between the login page fetch and the POST. That's my error, not an app issue. This is a testing artifact.

I don't need to prove the browser login fully; the direct-access grant already proves testuser credentials and client config work. The form login works generally in Keycloak. The "cookie not found" is my own artifact.

Let me re-do properly to confirm the full authorization code flow end-to-end (which is the path the frontend uses).
